verdict.rationale: Bun keeps its own global package cache at `~/.bun/install/cache` (configurable via `BUN_INSTALL_CACHE_DIR`), hardlinks packages from it into projects, and can run offline-only from that cache, so reinstalls reuse downloaded packages. The evidence never covers prebuilt native binaries versus compiling from source. Bun skips dependency lifecycle scripts unless the package is trusted, and a community commenter only speculates that it can run node-gyp. Missing for 10: documented support for prebuilt platform-specific binaries, explicit avoidance of native compilation, and independent or hands-on corroboration of binary installs from the cache.
